description: This file contains JavaScript code responsible for rendering the RDD DAG visualization in the Spark UI, including functions for rendering, layout setup, and interaction handling.

methods.name: expandDagVizArrowKey
methods.description: Returns the localStorage key for the expand/collapse arrow based on whether it's for a job or stage.

methods.name: toggleDagViz
methods.description: Shows or hides the RDD DAG visualization, rendering it if necessary, and toggling display state.

methods.name: renderDagViz
methods.description: Main function to render the DAG visualization for either a job or stage, setting up the SVG and marking cached or special RDDs.

methods.name: renderDagVizForStage
methods.description: Renders the DAG visualization on the stage page using a DOT file.

methods.name: renderDagVizForJob
methods.description: Renders the DAG visualization on the job page, handling multiple stages and cross-stage edges.

methods.name: setupLayoutForClusters
methods.description: Adjusts the layout of clusters in the graph, positioning labels and expanding cluster sizes.

methods.name: getMaxChildWidthAndPaddingTop
methods.description: Calculates maximum width and padding for child clusters.

methods.name: renderDot
methods.description: Renders a DOT graph as SVG using dagre-d3.

methods.name: graphContainer
methods.description: Returns the D3 selection of the container for the DAG graph.

methods.name: metadataContainer
methods.description: Returns the D3 selection of the container holding metadata for visualization.

methods.name: isStage
methods.description: Checks if a node ID corresponds to a stage cluster.

methods.name: preprocessGraphLayout
methods.description: Prepares the graph layout by setting styles, curves, and separation parameters.

methods.name: resizeSvg
methods.description: Adjusts the SVG viewBox and size to fit all graph elements.

methods.name: interpretLineBreak
methods.description: Enables line breaks in text spans with '\n' in labels.

methods.name: drawCrossStageEdges
methods.description: Draws edges crossing stage boundaries manually.

methods.name: getAbsolutePosition
methods.description: Calculates the absolute position of a graph element in the SVG.

methods.name: connectRDDs
methods.description: Draws a curved edge between two RDD nodes on the job page.

methods.name: addTooltipsForRDDs
methods.description: Adds tooltips to RDD nodes for additional info.

methods.name: toFloat
methods.description: Converts a value to a float, removing 'px' if present.
